create_quantlinear_2bit: create a QuantLinear module with 2-bit quantization for a given input and output feature size
create_quantlinear_4bit: create a QuantLinear module with 4-bit quantization and custom group size for compressed inference
pack_quantlinear_weights: pack a standard linear layer weight into the QuantLinear module using scales and zeros
warmup_quantlinear_model: warm up a Triton-based quantized model before inference with a specified sequence length
review_quantlinear_pack: review the QuantLinear pack method to understand how weights are quantized and bit-packed
